angle: Achieving family stability and financial freedom through strategic property investment, overcoming past struggles and the 'treadmill' of traditional work.
body_text:
Not everyone starts from a place of advantage.

I didn’t grow up around property investors or financial mentors.
Most of what I know today came from curiosity, mistakes, and learning along the way.

Over time, I’ve also been fortunate to learn from experienced mentors
who shaped how I think about property, strategy, and long-term decisions.

But behind everything I share today is something more personal — family.

Because for me, property was never just about buying assets.
It was about creating the stability I wished my family had growing up.

Everyone’s journey looks different.

What was the moment that changed how you started thinking about money?
👉 Drop it in the comments — curious to hear your story.

— Randy

#PropertyExitAdvantage #PropertyBanking #SingaporeProperty

transcript_text: By the age of 34, I had bought 22 properties and exited 7 properties. Today, the portfolio generates around $9,000 a month in passive income. There was a time when I was working 3 jobs and still worried about me. I grew up in a humble family. My father was once caught in an investment scam and we lost almost everything. That was the moment I realized we were really struggling. Before the Navy, I worked 3 part-time jobs while studying in poly just to support myself and help my family. So I joined the Navy for stability so I could help support my family. But over time, I realized something. The job that was supposed to give my family stability was also taking me further away from them. And life slowly started to feel like a treadmill. Working harder every year, but not really moving forward. One day, I came across a quote by Warren Buffett. He said, If you don't find a way to make money while you sleep, you will work until you die. That line hit me hard. That was when I started looking at property differently. Not just buying, understanding strategy, numbers, and exit planning. So that one day, my money could start working for me even while I sleep. Over the years, property helped me build long-term wealth. By the age of 34, I had bought 22 properties and exited 7 properties. Today, the portfolio generates around $9,000 a month in passive income. And most importantly, I'm able to give my family the stability I didn't grow up with. If you're carrying a lot on your shoulders right now, just know that things can change.
